proposals.title: Special Shareholder Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw changes giving holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons: The Board believes it is important that shareholders have a meaningful right to call special shareholder meetings

proposals.title: Board Diversity Matrix
proposals.proponent: City of New York Retirement Systems
proposals.topic_summary: Requests disclosure of each director's gender and race/ethnicity plus skills, experience and attributes in a matrix form in the proxy and website.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons: The Board agrees that diversity, including gender and ethnicity, is a key attribute

proposals.title: Report on Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report on direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association memberships and oversight decision processes.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons: The Board fully supports accountability and appropriate transparency and disclosure of lobbying activities
